segments.speaker: ANALYST
segments.text: Thanks for having me. I'd like to understand how cafes order from you today, and what the new ordering site needs to do.

segments.speaker: OWNER
segments.text: About 40 cafes phone or text their orders, and we write them on a whiteboard. Something goes wrong every week.

segments.speaker: OWNER
segments.text: We want each cafe to have its own login and place its orders online.

segments.speaker: DISPATCH
segments.text: Orders have to be in by 2 in the afternoon for delivery the next morning.

segments.speaker: ANALYST
segments.text: What should happen if a cafe orders after two?

segments.speaker: DISPATCH
segments.text: Then the site should offer the next delivery day after that instead.

segments.speaker: OWNER
segments.text: Hafez also wants standing orders, the same order every weekday, so they don't have to order each day.

segments.speaker: ACCOUNTS
segments.text: For billing, each café gets one invoice a week, emailed every Monday.

segments.speaker: ACCOUNTS
segments.text: And the invoices have to end up in zero. That's our accounting system.

segments.speaker: ANALYST
segments.text: How do cafes pay at the moment?

segments.speaker: ACCOUNTS
segments.text: Mostly bank transfer, um? I think, maybe we should let them pay by card on the site too? I'm not sure the fees are worth it.

segments.speaker: OWNER
segments.text: The site has to work well on phones. Most cafe owners order at five in the morning, standing behind the counter.

segments.speaker: DISPATCH
segments.text: For us the key thing is a packing list. Right after the QTOF, we need a list of everything to bake, grouped by delivery route.

segments.speaker: ANALYST
segments.text: Should prices include GST?

segments.speaker: ACCOUNTS
segments.text: No, show wholesale prices without GST, and add the GST on the invoice.

segments.speaker: OWNER
segments.text: And maybe cafes could rate each product? I don't know. We'll see.

segments.speaker: ANALYST
segments.text: Thanks. I'll write this up, and we'll meet again next week.

segments.speaker: ANALYST
segments.text: I've shared last week's notes, is there anything to change?

segments.speaker: DISPATCH
segments.text: Yes, the cut -off. We've started baking earlier, so orders for the next morning have to be in by noon, not to.

segments.speaker: DISPATCH
segments.text: And on the packing list, we need each cafe's delivery notes. Like leave it at the back door.

segments.speaker: ANALYST
segments.text: On payments, did you look at the card fees?

segments.speaker: ACCOUNTS
segments.text: Yes, we'll take card payments on the site, but the cafe pays a 1 .5 % surcharge.

segments.speaker: OWNER
segments.text: Hum. I'm not sure cafes will like a surcharge. But okay, let's try it.

segments.speaker: OWNER
segments.text: About standing orders, cafes need to change one day of a standing order up to the cut -off. Say 10 extra croissants for Saturday.

segments.speaker: OWNER
segments.text: And the product ratings, let's drop that. We don't need it.

segments.speaker: ACCOUNTS
segments.text: We also need a credit limit. If a cafe owes more than $2 ,000, the site should block new orders.

segments.speaker: DISPATCH
segments.text: We can't just stop delivering. If a cafe gets no bread one morning, we lose them. Driver us should still deliver, and accounts can chase the money.

segments.speaker: ANALYST
segments.text: Let's leave the credit limit open for now and come back to it.

segments.speaker: OWNER
segments.text: One more thing. The site must be available from four in the morning every day, because that's when the first cafes order.

segments.speaker: ANALYST
segments.text: Today I'd like to settle the open items for the first release. First. Zero.

segments.speaker: DEVLEAD
segments.text: Xero's API lets us create the invoices directly, so accounts won't have to type anything in.

segments.speaker: OWNER
segments.text: Good, let's do that.

segments.speaker: ANALYST
segments.text: Last time we said the site should work well on phones. Can we make that measurable?

segments.speaker: DEVLEAD
segments.text: The order page should load in under 3 seconds on a mobile connection.

segments.speaker: OWNER
segments.text: Yes, three seconds is fine.

segments.speaker: ANALYST
segments.text: And the credit limit?

segments.speaker: OWNER
segments.text: Um, I still haven't decided. I need to talk to accounts and dispatch together first.

segments.speaker: ANALYST
segments.text: Last thing, do cafes need to see their order history?

segments.speaker: OWNER
segments.text: Yes, the last three months, so they can reorder quickly.

segments.speaker: ANALYST
segments.text: Great. I'll update the requirements and send them round by Friday.
